messages:
sam (sec): ACME retest intake: need final sign-off on ephemeral KMS grant model, evidence export path, and a short rollback playbook. Can we schedule the retest and a dry-run?

tara (ops): Ops can do Thu morning. Suggest Thu 09:30-11:30 PT for the main window and Thu 08:45 for a dry-run. Is that ok for SRE/security?

liam (platform): Hold Thu 09:30-11:30 PT tentatively. We'll validate cross-region key policies and grant TTLs. Also want to confirm we won't give Decrypt on the CMK.

anita (sre): SRE ok with that slot. We'll tail the service logs and export 5-minute snapshots to the evidence bucket. Need a stable request_id propagated through token issuance and model-serving layers.

emma (eng): I can thread request_id through responses. Also: do assessors need direct ELK access or just the readroom?

sam (sec): Compliance prefers readroom S3 with a manifest and signed metadata for chain-of-custody. No direct ELK access.

josh (compliance): Confirming: S3 readroom must include manifest.sha256, metadata.json (who accessed what), and CloudTrail slices for key events (CreateGrant, GenerateDataKey). Need cryptographic proof that CMK material never left AWS KMS.

tara (ops): We'll create a temporary bucket `s3://acme-pt-readroom-2026` with object prefix `acme/retest/1755554321/`. Presigned URLs will be created per artifact and expire at retention end. Lifecycle 45d by default.

liam (platform): Proposed grant model: use GenerateDataKey/Encrypt on ephemeral data keys and deny CMK Decrypt. Example CLI snippet for grant creation and constraint:```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/acme-pt-cmk --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/PT-AssessorRole --operations GenerateDataKey Encrypt Decrypt --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset": {"engagement":"acme-retest","artifact":"evidence"}}'```

liam (platform): We'll attach `audit_scope=acme-retest` tag to grants and automatically revoke grants after the window via an automated revoke job.

anita (sre): Runbook items: 1) dry-run revoke at Thu 08:45, 2) live revoke on incident, 3) rotate alias after window if any suspicious activity. We'll test revoke automation on the dry-run.

emma (eng): For evidence packaging I'll add a script that collects: app logs (request_id), CloudTrail slices, KMS event exports, and a manifest with sha256 checksums. Sample:```bash
find snapshots -type f -name '*.log' -exec sha256sum {} \; > manifest.sha256
jq -n --argjson ids '[]' '{"request_ids": $ids}' > metadata.json
```

josh (compliance): Please include an access ledger in metadata.json listing presigned URL issuance events and assessor principal ARNs. That ledger should be signed by the ops team with an HMAC key stored in KMS.

tara (ops): We'll emit a signed ledger using a temporary HMAC key generated under the CMK and include the HMAC proof in the evidence bundle. Presigned URLs scoped to `s3://acme-pt-readroom-2026/acme/retest/1755554321/*`.

liam (platform): IAM for assessors: use STS AssumeRole with 1h duration, policy limited to `s3:GetObject` for the evidence prefix and no KMS:Decrypt on CMK. If assessors request decrypted payloads, we can provide data decrypted with ephemeral data keys but not the CMK.

sam (sec): Agreed: no CMK Decrypt. Also add CloudTrail playback proof: hashed sequence of events showing GenerateDataKey/CreateGrant for the exact time range.

anita (sre): Oncall will push 15m snapshots to the evidence prefix and post a short digest to #eng-sre. We'll capture service metrics and error traces too.

emma (eng): I'll add `audit_meta.request_id` to all function outputs and ensure it's present in the build manifest. Also pushing a small patch to the token service to log `request_id` on issuance.

sam (sec): Remediation/tracking: P1s that affect auth to KMS or token issuance are blockers. Emma please add items to the tracker and assign owners. Josh will validate compliance acceptance criteria.

emma (eng): Tracker entry created: https://redwood.internal/pt/ACME-RETEST-42  will add checklist and owners by EOD.

josh (compliance): Acceptance criteria summary: manifest + checksums, CloudTrail slices, access ledger with HMAC proof, no CMK export, and documented rollback steps.

tara (ops): Ops tasks: provision bucket, HMAC signing job, presigned URL generator, lifecycle policy.

liam (platform): Platform tasks: grant/rotation automation, sample CLI snippets, and a revoke playbook. I'll drop the CLI examples in the tracker.

anita (sre): SRE tasks: schedule dry-run Thu 08:45, run revoke test, capture snapshots to evidence prefix. I'll be oncall.

emma (eng): Engineering tasks: propagate request_id, implement manifest script, and add build hooks for evidence packaging.

sam (sec): I'll draft rollback playbook and emergency contacts and post to the tracker. If no blockers we'll proceed with Thu slot.

tara (ops): No blockers from ops. Bucket will be ready by Wed EOD.

liam (platform): No blockers from platform.

anita (sre): No blockers from SRE. Dry-run scheduled.

emma (eng): No blockers from eng.

deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled for Thu 08:45  executed: revoke automation exercised and uploaded logs to s3://acme-pt-readroom-2026/acme/retest/1755554321/dryrun/. Basic smoke checks passed.

sam (sec): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll finalize the retest invite and attach the rollback playbook to the tracker.
